thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Streaming tail latency p99 > 5s in eu-west-1 across SSE/WebSocket routes. SLO breach (p99 threshold 2s). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/streams/incident/5234567890

jordan: taking pager — pinging runtime and edge to triage now
maria: seeing a correlated spike on edge-proxy-3 (eu-west-1). write latency spiking, nginx reports `write() failed: Connection timed out` in the last 3m
ben: can you confirm whether this is chunking (partial chunks sent) or full stall?
jordan: looks like chunking stalls — clients receive initial chunks then long gaps (5-15s) between subsequent chunks. websockets show long frame gaps too.
eng-sre: alerted. grabbing tcpdump + proxy traces from edge-proxy-3
eng-runtime: looking at model-serving side too — no CPU/GPU pressure on the model host pool, but KV cache RPCs have intermittent latency spikes to 100-300ms
maria: nginx error excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z error upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while sending to client, client: 10.4.5.12, server: api.redwood, request: "GET /v1/stream?client=js HTTP/1.1"
```
ben: reproduction attempt (local):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  "https://eu-west-1.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-lite" | hexdump -C | head -n 40
```
jordan: reproduced similar tail gaps from eu-west-1 to my laptop. stacktrace suggests proxy write wait then socket close.
customer-success-bot: Notifying affected customers: AcmeCorp (id:c-821), BetaProducts (id:c-1102), internal-beta. CS will send status update in 30m.
ops_lead: high level numbers? how many requests affected?
maria: short window metrics (5m): streaming traffic p95=1.1s, p99=5.6s, error-rate(5m)=0.9% (up from 0.05%). Affected request share ~2.8% of total streaming QPS (mainly SSE endpoints).
jordan: root suspects: 1) edge-proxy write buffering + OS socket backpressure 2) client slow consumers causing long-lived connections 3) intermittent KV cache latency causing server-side stalls
eng-runtime: confirm KV cache RPCs show increased tail latencies after our 09:10 deploy, rolling back isn't ideal right now. Suggest immediate mitigations: route traffic off edge-proxy-3, reduce proxy write timeout to 15s -> 7s, and enable model fallback to quantized variant for eu-west-1.
ben: quick config snippet to reduce proxy write timeout (nginx):
```nginx
proxy_send_timeout 7s;
proxy_read_timeout 7s;
send_timeout 7s;
```
maria: also saw many client `slow consumer` logs — Node streams that don't drain. Could be a spike in mobile clients on flaky networks.
eng-sre: routing 20% of eu-west-1 streaming traffic to eu-west-2 as a mitigation. Doing gradual shift now.
jordan: executing temporary routing change (canary 20%) and lowering timeouts. If chunk gaps persist we drop connections earlier to prevent head-of-line blocking.
eng-runtime: enabling fallback model redwood-lite-quantized in eu-west-1 for streaming endpoints (lower throughput but faster per-token latency). Will monitor quality alerts.
customer-success-bot: CS draft sent to impacted customers: "We are investigating increased tail latency for streaming responses in eu-west-1. We have applied temporary mitigations and will follow up with RCA."
maria: after routing shift and timeout tweak, p99 dropped from 5.6s -> 2.4s within 4 minutes. p95 stable ~1.1s. Error rate trending down.
ben: logs show a reduction of `write() failed` and fewer stuck connections.
jordan: current mitigation plan (short):
- keep 20% cross-region routing until p99 < 2s for 15m
- roll model fallback permanently for next 2 hours if stable
- instrument additional streaming traces (per-request chunk timing)
- notify CS for customer updates

ops_lead: any customer-visible sessions still stalled?
maria: small handful (~12 session ids) still showing >10s gaps — likely slow consumer devices. We can attempt websocket keepalive tweaks to detect and close.
eng-sre: pushing a minor keepalive change on edge-proxy to detect dead TCP peers earlier:
```bash
# on envoy / haproxy side example
--tcp-keepalive-idle=30
--tcp-keepalive-interval=10
--tcp-keepalive-probes=3
```
jordan: OK handoff plan: I'm stabilizing now, will hand to @alex for the 09:30-11:30 shift. Alex — please monitor p99, rollback the fallback only if quality regressions, and start RCA with eng-runtime + eng-sre.
alex: ack — taking over at 5234567938. will set a 15m watch and coordinate postmortem.
eng-runtime: recording mitigations in incident tracker: https://tracker.redwood.ai/incident/5234567890/mitigations
eng-sre: collecting tcpdump + proxy traces for RCA. saving artifacts to /artifacts/incidents/5234567890/
customer-success-bot: CS will send an update in 15m confirming mitigations and expected follow-up.

jordan: notes for RCA: correlate deploys around 09:10, KV cache tail latency changes, and increased client connection count. possible load pattern change: more long-lived mobile SSE clients.
maria: temp mitigation rollback criteria: sustained p99 < 2s for 30m and error-rate < 0.2%
eng-runtime: will also run a throttled load test to validate new proxy timeouts and fallback behavior before removing mitigations.

alex: handoff complete — leaving watch and will update in-thread with any regressions. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT status -> mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned to eng-runtime & eng-sre for RCA. Priority: P2.

alex: initial customer impact summary to include in PM: affected customers ~3 (partial), peak p99 5.6s, impacted request share ~2.8% of streaming QPS, short-lived — mitigations applied within ~8 minutes.

end."
